text:
sam_cs: FYI — onboarding for NorthBridge starts in 90m. They want a tiny field kit: 1) one-page PM checklist (non-technical) and 2) a paste-ready infra snippet for engineers covering caching, batching, streaming. Focus: reduce week-1 renewal risk.

lia_csm: Ill draft the PM one-pager. Can we offer three preset profiles with copyable numbers (safe / standard / throughput)? PMs like pick-and-paste.

don_sre: Agreed. Engineer defaults I recommend (copy these):
- Safe: ttl=30s, max_batch_gpu=8, max_batch_cpu=4, stream_chunk=64
- Standard: ttl=150s, max_batch_gpu=16, max_batch_cpu=6, stream_chunk=128
- Throughput: ttl=450s, max_batch_gpu=32, max_batch_cpu=8, stream_chunk=256
Enable prefix+LRU cache, warm pools first 48h, and a fallback to smaller model if p95 > 350ms.

don_sre: Paste-ready JSON snippet for engineers (single block):
```json
{"cache":"prefix_lru","kv_mb":"128","ttl_s":"150","batching":{"max_batch_gpu":"16","max_batch_cpu":"6","batch_timeout_ms":"20"},"streaming":{"chunk_tokens":"128","stream_window_ms":"80"},"slo":{"p95_ms":"250","fallback_sync_after_ms":"300"}}
```

maya_support: PM checklist (short):
1) Day0 smoke: run 5 representative prompts end-to-end; confirm partial streaming tokens arrive and p95 < 300ms.
2) Day1 prime: send 8-12 representative queries per heavy user to warm caches.
3) Day3 telemetry: review p95, error rate, cache hit% (target >35% by Day3).
4) Day7 renewal check: if p95 > 400ms or cache hit < 20% or errors spike, escalate to CSM + SRE.

maya_support: Quick triage commands to include for engineers:
redwoodctl metrics query --customer northbridge --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 48h
redwoodctl metrics query --customer northbridge --metric p95_latency,error_rate --window 24h
redwoodctl logs tail --customer northbridge --filter "stream_error" --since 1h

don_sre: Fast mitigations to call out: switch to Safe profile, halve max_batch_size, reduce batch_timeout_ms to 10ms, or disable prefix cache temporarily if key churn is high. For CPU-only infra use max_batch_cpu=4 and batch_timeout_ms=50.

lia_csm: Add a tiny Day7 feedback snippet for PMs: 1) Are outputs meeting expectations? (yes/no + note) 2) Any responses >500ms observed? (yes/no + example) 3) Any streaming truncation/gaps? (yes/no). Well ingest answers into CS dashboard.

ops-bot: scheduled task "prefill-top-keys" for northbridge at 2025-06-20T09:00:00Z :gear:

sam_cs: Owners: Lia=PM one-pager + email template, Don=engineer snippet + triage notes, Maya=run Day0 and Day3 checks. I'll coordinate Day7 with AE. Post any edge-case notes (very short tokens, chatty UIs) here before EOD. :white_check_mark:
